_comment: Hook wiring (plans/hooks_plan.md). Scripts gate themselves on ADW_TICKET_RUN where a rule should only bind harness-driven runs; destructive-command and branch-policy denials are always on. Launcher runs the script with cwd pinned to CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR (fallback '.') so a cwd leaked by a session's `cd` cannot break hook invocation (bench5 SA-v2 lockouts, RUN.md 2026-08-04); pure-python env read keeps it shell-agnostic (sh and cmd verified).

hooks.command: uv run --quiet python -c "import os,sys,subprocess; r=os.environ.get('CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR') or '.'; sys.exit(subprocess.run([sys.executable,'hooks/pretooluse_guard.py'], stdin=sys.stdin, cwd=r).returncode)"
